name: Navarro's Jewelry
audience: Downtown San Jose professionals, promise-ring and wedding clients, watch and heirloom repairs
description: Oscar Navarro's downtown shop since 1987: same-day repairs, custom design and a bench that serves the courthouse crowd as often as the collectors.
serviceCopy: Sizing, repairs and re-tipping, same day.
Custom pieces drawn with the maker.
Estate restoration with a paper trail.
Wedding sets for the courthouse week.
insight: Proximity to the Santa Clara County courthouse is an unexploited demand engine: elopement-ring traffic is literal walk-in business.
usps: Walk-in custom design with a maker at the bench
differentiators: Publishes same-day service windows and a ring quiz that ends in an appointment, not an email list
persona: The downtown bench of San Jose

reputation.note: Perfect score with real volume over nearly four decades.

afford: Custom design tickets $2K-$30K; decades of accumulated inventory relationships
Same-day service implies bench capacity that a booking flow would multiply
risk: Owner-operated: content and photo capture need a service, not advice
Two jewelry shops in this database must not look alike: differentiate hard
